result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd shortlist **BambooHR, Employment Hero, Rippling and Zoho People**\. The best choice depends on whether you need straightforward employee management, Australian payroll integration, recruitment, performance reviews or a complete HR system.

If your business is based in Australia, I'd put **Employment Hero** near the top of the list because of its Australian employment and payroll focus.

## My top 5 HR software recommendations

![2025 Employment Hero Annual Jobs Report Reveals a Workforce Under Pressure, On the Move, and Rewriting the Rules](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c72cfBM-wnkCY2sXvC-N2bdeXlozX_a6cLpeiRcNWIdO5skRSiJsO0H69D4TjL37larxeB9RHeRje9o33vXlesf4SGbT2cKN9yyK2lD71zg8gVLQUlVbvzPmQ7XZL_7bga6vNjcRIhuVAHDdb80aC6efbG65m_LmQQnOM37zl4ReRd-YURSotCy3M4QrvYQn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Employment Hero**

(Best for Australian small businesses)

- Employee records and onboarding
- Leave and attendance management
- Payroll and employment documentation
- Performance management
- Australian employment-focused tools

Best if you want HR and payroll closely connected.

[Visit Employment Hero](https://employmenthero.com/)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best overall HR platform)

- Excellent employee database
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- Leave management
- Reporting and analytics

Best if you want a polished, easy-to-use HR system rather than payroll software.

[Visit BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

- HR, payroll and IT management
- Automated onboarding and offboarding
- Employee document management
- Workflow automation
- Integrations with other business systems

Best for businesses expecting significant growth.

[Visit Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee records
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management
- Custom HR workflows

Best if you want affordable HR software without paying for a huge suite.

[Visit Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![HiBob Company Profile – Israel Office | Secret Tel Aviv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VqtrRaPcgUicXO-4Ys0LiaPCrKe-5CJsa6TkSYgK1KcefpQhkEpEHerjMriA1N5YlEChNgmd7rQjSw27yQX48bFCzMJuRS79dEcVkcuDFBzyX6mwJYyF0haiasPADaDYIeAoykjLgSELovlBtSVFVxZrjW7VMjyk6qPW9KpNiwrWMbEgzHfDR3XQ7fQVHM0g?purpose=fullsize)

- Employee engagement
- Performance reviews
- Employee lifecycle management
